findings.scenario: A host scope written to the published one-argument contract, fn (Builder $query) => $query->where('enabled', true), is invoked as ($this->scope)($narrow, $context). On PHP ^8.3 that non-variadic closure throws ArgumentCountError before it can add a grouped WHERE. roleGrants therefore yields no membership contribution; AuthorityStage catches Throwable and denies with SourceError. contextsCovering throws the same Error instead of an AssignmentScopeSelection. A member of an enabled project is denied, and a callback that changes select/join/limit never reaches the structure check because ArgumentCountError is not InvalidSourceContributionException.
